world: X is uniform on the 6x6 grid {-3,-2,-1,1,2,3}/3. Task Y agrees with sign(x0+0.7*x1) with probability 9/10. Secret S equals Y flipped independently with regime probability q. The only logical observation is one model label followed by randomized-response probability rho; no weights, inputs, timings, identifiers, logs or adaptive queries are included.

cart_depth2.split: minimum weighted Gini; ascending feature/threshold tie-break; class zero on tied leaf counts

allocation: All 168 attempted models, four regimes and three controls remain in scope: 2016 two-row channel families plus 504 utility families. At n=20000 and e=1/50, the combined Hoeffding failure upper is (4*2016+504)/sum_{k=0}^{32}(16^k/k!), an exact rational upper on 8568*exp(-16), below 0.05. Utility draws are shared across regimes, not counted as new families each time.
selection: Among candidates meeting both risk and utility constraints, select the largest rho (least informative binary randomized response). Otherwise redesign. Point comparator uses identical draws and empirical endpoints. No retrospective threshold, control, model, seed or sample-size changes.
primary_endpoints: Any selected candidate has exact oracle risk above threshold or utility below minimum; denominator all attempted models, separately by family/regime.
An oracle-feasible candidate exists but the simultaneous-bound rule selects none; denominator all attempted models, separately by family/regime.
primary_model_uncertainty: For the simultaneous-bound rule only, report Hoeffding intervals with halfwidth 1/5 across 84 independent fits for each of 16 primary means (two endpoints x two families x four regimes). Joint failure is bounded by 32*exp(-2*84/25)<0.05. Paired regimes/controls are not new model replications. Conditional useful-selection rates and comparator differences are secondary descriptive results.
secondary_endpoints: Useful selection conditional on an oracle-feasible candidate
Correct redesign when no oracle-feasible candidate exists
Channel interval coverage, width and CLEAR/HOLD/BLOCK frequencies
Paired point-estimate comparator safety violations and abstention
negative_controls: rho=1/5 cannot meet utility 3/4 because Bayes task accuracy is 9/10 and randomized-response utility is at most 37/50.
Depth-2 axis-aligned trees have maximum task accuracy 73/90 in this world; their rho=1/10 utility is at most 337/450, below 3/4.
The high-leakage regime has no candidate jointly meeting risk 13/20 and utility 3/4; correct redesign is not counted as useful release.
oracle_relation: Risk = 1/2 + (1-2q)*abs(released task accuracy-1/2). This deliberately controlled relationship is not a general empirical privacy-utility law.
failure_handling: Save training draws before fitting. Any training, verifier or integrity error stops the run with retained partial evidence, distinct planned/attempted/evaluated counts, and no confirmatory model-level confidence intervals. Failed fits have no invented oracle outcome. Do not substitute another seed, remove a failed fit, overwrite or silently resume; any later run requires a separately identified registration.
scope_limits: Synthetic finite population, small independently trained classifiers, and one bounded logical label; not training-membership privacy, CNN/LLM replication, adaptive or joint-release security, deployment or government effectiveness.
Seeded pseudorandom streams implement the declared IID ideal sampling model; this is not a theorem about generator randomness or machine arithmetic during training.
The study's explicit Hoeffding selector is not the complete MRA engine/optimizer/government authorization workflow. Native pipeline and lifecycle regressions are reported separately.
No human data or participants are used. No governmental/ethics review package or institutional approval is part of this study.
The registration is hash-frozen locally before confirmatory fits, without independent timestamping or external preregistration.
